data.name: Peter
data.gender_notes: Peter is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek petros (πέτρος), 'rock, stone', a translation of the Aramaic Kepha. Its root is Greek petra (πέτρα). Simon Peter, the apostle (Matthew 16:18). Peter is a Greek name meaning “Rock; stone”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Peter expresses “Rock; stone”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek petros (πέτρος), 'rock, stone', a translation of the Aramaic Kepha.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Peter total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
